about.cap: A Nostr conference from Japan where people gather. And a festival.
about.lead:
A Nostr conference from Japan.
And a <m>festival.</m>
about.nostrasiaText: Started in 2023, it is a place where people who build Nostr, use it, or are curious about it come together. Past editions have had talks, hands-on sessions, a market, and even a shrine. The 2024 and 2025 editions were held in Tokyo, and a 2026 edition is planned.
about.nostrText: A decentralized protocol (a way of communicating) that doesn't depend on any particular company or server. A pair of keys, npub (public key) and nsec (private key), is your account. Your posts are stored on multiple relays (servers that keep and deliver posts), and you can read and write with any app (client) you like. You can cheer on posts you like with a zap ⚡ (a feature for sending a small amount of bitcoin).

faq.cap: Answers to common questions, such as keys and relays.
faq.lead:
Don't worry.
<m>Everyone is new at first.</m>

first.q: Can I come if I've never used Nostr?
first.a: How to join will be announced once decided. Past editions had hands-on sessions for first-timers. The 2026 program is TBA.

fee.a: The fee hasn't been decided yet. We'll announce it once it is.

when.q: When will the date and venue be decided?
when.a: Both are TBA. We'll announce them on our official accounts (X @nostrasia / Bluesky nostrasia.com / note / Nostr) once decided.

keys.a: npub is an ID that identifies you, and it's fine to share. nsec is a secret key that only you hold. Unlike a password, it can't be reissued if you lose it. Never show it to anyone.

relay.a: A server that keeps and delivers posts. You connect to several relays at once, so even if one goes down, the same posts remain on the others.

zap.a: A feature for sending a small amount of bitcoin (Lightning) to a post. A slightly more serious cheer than a “like”.

client.title: Pick an app (client)
client.text: Choose one: a phone app or one that runs in your browser.

keys.title: Make your keys
keys.text: npub is an ID you can share; nsec is a secret key you keep to yourself. No sign-up with an email address is needed.

relay.title: Connect to relays
relay.text: Your posts are stored on the relays you connect to. You can add or remove relays later.

post.title: Post with #{{tag}}
post.text: Use the hashtag and build up to the day together.
